purpose: Pre-freeze blind semantic audit of public-benchmark model-round and benchmark-fixture authority contracts.

acceptance_checks.stderr_diagnostic: Two model-catalog refresh child-process timeout messages were observed; final process exit, output Schema, and single-thread checks still passed.

result.summary: The evidenced OpenWorker MILAI_MCP path needs two visible native vLLM calls: one tool decision and one terminal answer after the MCP result. Case-level denominator symmetry does not require equal native-call totals.
result.hidden_or_extra_definition: Any native model call outside the frozen arm-specific planned roles is hidden or extra; the two visible MILAI_MCP rounds are planned and hidden_or_extra remains zero.
result.denominator_policy: One scheduled observation per frozen case per arm; native call totals and failures remain separately reported without exclusion or reweighting.
result.token_policy: Freeze one aggregate per-case token ceiling and account cumulatively across all planned calls; do not multiply a per-call ceiling by model rounds.
result.authority_policy: Use an explicit frozen benchmark-fixture ingestion policy in an isolated fresh benchmark database/tenant and scope. ACTION_SAFE canonicality is only a benchmark-fixture property and must not be represented as production authority.
result.one_call_alternative: No one-call alternative is supported by the executed adapter semantics; prefetching MCP outside the OpenWorker agent would weaken the stated arm.

finding_summaries.title: All-arms one-call expectation contradicts the required MILAI_MCP path.
Two planned MILAI_MCP calls are visible rounds, not hidden/extra calls.
Case-level denominator symmetry does not imply native-call symmetry.
Same model identity/settings do not require equal arm architecture.
Equal per-call limits do not establish an equal total per-case budget.
Benchmark fixture authority must remain isolated from production authority.
This is pre-freeze development advice, not formal acceptance.

boundary: This receipt records an AI development audit only. It is not CRG-01, CRG-02, a human decision, a benchmark score, or permission to open test labels/outputs.
